properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): recording an owner's answer takes two calls. answer_question takes only the gap/question id and the answer text. The 2026-09-02 settlement made "which record this answer became" a separate ANSWERS tool rather than an argument, and a Question has no field for WHO answered or WHOM it was put to. Its `answer` is defined as "what the user said", so an answer relayed from an owner outside the chat reads as the chat user's own
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-09-29, items I25 and I29 of art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29.

① OBSERVED (flo2 design 50f966697d6c5024, reflow2 0.74.0). For each owner answer the designer called answer_question and then a separate `answers` edge from the record the answer became, as detect-and-ask says to: 4 extra calls in round 2. The owner was a separate agent reached only through the hub session, which carried every question batch by hand. The designer kept its question-number → node-id map in a scratch file outside the design (ikg-round1-question-map.md). Expected: one call records the answer, what it became and who gave it, and the design itself holds which questions went to whom. NOT affected: answering a question the chat user answered, which works.

② PRECEDENT.
- dec:idea-how-should-the-loop-know-that-an-answer-reached-the-design (accepted 2026-09-02): option C, the ANSWERS edge, was shipped as chg:a-record-can-say-which-question-it-answered.
- req:the-loop-says-what-is-owed-to-a-person (proposed): loop_status(contributor_id) attributes ASSIGNED DECISIONS (approver edges) and owned-ground gaps, not Questions.
- fact:seven-open-questions-had-already-shipped-their-answers-2026-09-14.
Nothing on questions addressed to someone not in the session.

③ CANDIDATES.
(a) answer_question predates ANSWERS, and the edge was added as a tool, not as an argument.
(b) The Question model assumes one implicit human in the chat: no addressee, no answerer.
(c) NOT THE COMPONENT SUSPECTED: the relay was the exercise's choice (the hub withheld the owner's design tools on purpose).
(d) The observation is wrong: answer_question already takes an answerer or a record.

④⑤ MEASURED 2026-09-29.
· AnswerQuestionReq (service.rs ~5868) has gap_id, question_id and answer, and nothing else. (d) refuted, (a) confirmed.
· schema/core.yaml Question has question (immutable), gap_id, rephrase_degraded, asked_at, answer ("What the user said, in their own words. The design nodes it produced are linked separately") and status. There is no addressee and no answered_by, and an AUTHORED_BY edge on a Question is not read by loop_status's person scope. (b) confirmed.
· (c) partly upheld: a human owner on flo2 without an agent would hit the same absence. flo2 serves no browser view of open Questions (flo2 dec:idea-ruling-on-a-decision-from-the-browser and dec:idea-your-flo2-account-page-shows-your-designs are both open). So the relay was forced by the model, not only by the setup.

⑥ CLASS: the detect→ask→answer loop was designed for a single person in the same conversation as the agent. Decisions grew an addressee (the approver edge as assignment, read by loop_status per person), and Questions never did. So as soon as the asker and the answerer are different parties (a hub, a delegated owner, a manager answering from a chat app, the hub trial's goal of "end the human middleman"), the routing lives in files outside the design. Merging ANSWERS into answer_question alone would save calls and leave the routing unrecorded.

⑦⑧ OWED. No pinning test and no fix. The companion ideas (a question batch as a record, and an owner-scoped digest) are recorded as brainstorms.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED. Whether the loop should treat a Question put to a named person like an assigned decision (nagging that person, not the session). That is intent, and Anthony's.

CLOSED 2026-09-29: fixed by reflow2 PR #634 (squash b519bb1); its change record is in main's committed export, not this live store. Verified read-only on origin/main: answer_question takes answered_by, answered_at, record and note and draws ANSWERS in the same call (crates/reflow2-mcp/src/tools/ask.rs); schema/core.yaml Question carries asked_of, answered_by, answered_via, answered_at, batch and batch_position; gap_to_prompt / gaps_to_prompts take asked_of, batch and per-question evidence; open_questions(asked_of) returns one person's batch in order; loop_status(contributor_id) lists questions_put_to_them, which also answers ⑨ for the scoped read.
